# The U Basketball Prep Academy

> Elite basketball training academy in Glendale & Torrance, CA pairing professional basketball skills training in The Dojo with flexible online academics for middle and high school student-athletes. Backed by 30+ years developing NBA All-Stars, lottery picks, and top-tier youth prospects.

The U Basketball Prep Academy (also known as THE U PREP) is a training academy, not a school — and not a clinic or camp. Student-athletes train daily in "The Dojo" under a professional development staff while completing accredited academics through a family-chosen online school or homeschool program. The Academy provides the facility, supervised study time, structure, and elite training. It does not provide an academic curriculum, issue grades, award school credit, or replace the student's school. Parents and guardians remain responsible for the student's school enrollment, assignments, attendance, grades, and academic progress. Admission is application-based; families begin with a questionnaire and a facility walkthrough.

## Key Facts

- Official name: The U Basketball Prep Academy (THE U PREP)
- What it is: basketball training academy with supervised academic study time
- What it is not: a school, a clinic, or a rec league
- Locations: The Dojo — 1219 Los Angeles St., Glendale, CA 91204 (full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–12:30 PM) · Jump Beyond Sports — 1780 Oak St., Torrance, CA 90501 (part-time, Tuesday & Thursday, 10:00 AM–12:30 PM)
- Category: basketball training academy
- Audience: middle school and high school student-athletes enrolled in homeschool or accredited online academic programs
- Founder: Olin Simplis ("Coach O") — 30+ years developing NBA All-Stars, lottery picks, and top-tier youth prospects
- Training facility: The Dojo
- Program dates: September 8, 2026 – May 14, 2027
- Contact: theuacademyonline@gmail.com · +1-310-617-3254
- Social: Instagram @theubasketballprepacademy · X @TheUBballPrep · LinkedIn /company/the-u-basketball-prep-academy
- Enrollment: application-based for the 2026–2027 school year and upcoming semesters; 2:1 player-to-coach ratio; questionnaire → in-person walkthrough → confirm online or homeschool partner → non-refundable intake deposit upon acceptance
